_comment: Aura token. No JSON existed anywhere, so create_token's require_card raised MissingCardImplementation and ABORTED THE GAME the moment Pleiades' crowd-cheer trigger or pleiades_superstar's clash win resolved. "Can't be defended by more than 2 non-block cards" is a COUNT limit; RESTRICT_DEFENDERS named only WHICH cards may not defend, so max_defenders was added alongside it. Block is a card TYPE (CR 8.1.12), not a subtype.
